review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C input. The PRD explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical benchmark input without asserting a human Decision; only that branch is required. Thus ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate for C, while a material unresolved DEC-001 in B must still block at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, the two stable task keys, verification dependency, and seven evidence stages agree with the specification. The source shows classic and mini forwarding to core._stringbool, where normalization and truthy-first lookup currently occur. The exact writable scope of core/api.ts and the classic and proposed mini regression files is sufficient; forwarding/declaration consumers appropriately remain inspection owners, and build configuration supports treating emitted declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. Runtime and TypeScript validation are distinguished and supported by the supplied configuration. The allowed implementer and verifier have the relevant active project-scoped trusted capability claims, available slots, and appropriate roles; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. The independent active reviewer satisfies the stated non-executing review prerequisite. Release fingerprints agree between Gold and preview, and the provenance explains the distinct source-manifest/evaluation digest domains and PRD whitespace normalization. Historical operations are explicitly old-version records, not candidate evidence for this bundle. I relied on the supplied Service-calculated digest bindings and provenance; I did not independently recompute digests, execute code, or create human attestations. No material error or unresolved ambiguity was identified.
